name: smwpatches-pitchin-chuck-won-t-turn-on-extra-bit
title: Pitchin' Chuck Won't Turn On Extra Bit
description:
This patch makes it so that Pitchin' Chuck (sprite 98) will not turn to face Mario when throwing baseballs, if the extra bit is set (he will still face Mario on spawn).

For this patch to work properly, you must run PIXI on the ROM at least once.

Requested by Picayune.
